archetypes.name: resume-state-boundary
archetypes.rationale: Resume-state writes moved into wrappers with ordering-sensitive pause semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 3 and Step 2b wrapper changes for pause/resume ordering and all-or-nothing validation. Pay special attention to flag-bearing design-step3-review.sh calls, completion-only marker writes, and whether no-flag launches preserve the prior pause behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: prompt-contract-drift
archetypes.rationale: Large /design prose migration may leave stale raw-write instructions.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit SKILL.md and design references for stale prompt-side state writes or split write-then-resume patterns. Confirm migrated phase, findings, completion, and postplan continue paths consistently point at the wrapper-owned single-call contract. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
